newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour offers to cooperate on combat knives law.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour offers to cooperate on combat knives law.

text.p: Labour leader Tony Blair wrote to Prime Minister John Major on Thursday offering to cooperate on legislation to ban the sale of combat knives.
Ministers said the government would consider the offer carefully. "Offers of cooperation will always be considered constructively," one said.

Blair wrote to Major after the prime minister said on radio he would be "interested to get more offers" like the one he accepted from Labour on Wednesday to cooperate to pass legislation on stalking and a register of paedophiles.
Labour proposed a ban on the sale of knives to people under 16 last January following the murder of London headteacher Philip Lawrence.
Blair said a meeting between Home Secretary Michael Howard and the Labour and Liberal Democrats' home affairs spokesmen would help to overcome the problem of defining what is a combat knife.
